about: Bench scenarios of the page's bench mode (?bench=<name>, docs/real-machine-bench.md). file: the scenario (tools/headless.mjs language, src/host/scenario.js); manifests: the versions it plays (the first one by default, ?manifest= picks another); coords: the display its pointer coordinates were written for (scaled to the game's display); minutes: the usual duration once the game files are in the browser; maxSeconds: the bench stops there (a first launch downloads the files first).
